action_items: No API-bearing acceptance criterion exists; backend pytest suite collected 0 tests (static marketing site, no auth/DB per seed_facts).
Old checks testing now-removed features (membership pricing, enquiry forms, trainers/results placeholders) were retired and replaced with checks matching the new acceptance matrix.

checks.criterion: Membership/fees content is removed from the homepage and every branch page
checks.name: membership-content-removed
checks.evidence: Homepage and /branches/gudimalkapur body text contained no ₹ symbol, no 'Choose your commitment' heading, no 'membership' text, and no Memberships nav link.

checks.criterion: Clicking any branch from a lower homepage position opens that branch at the beginning
checks.name: branch-click-scrolls-top
checks.evidence: Clicked branch-view-nampally (last of 6 cards) from homepage; landed on /branches/nampally with branch-hero-nampally visible and window.scrollY === 0.

checks.criterion: The Work Shows results segment is completely removed
checks.name: work-shows-results-removed
checks.evidence: Homepage body text contained no 'The Work Shows' heading, no 'testimonial', and no 'transformation' placeholder content.

checks.criterion: Meet the Coaches and all trainer placeholders are removed everywhere
checks.name: coaches-trainers-removed
checks.evidence: Homepage and /branches/mangalhat contained no 'Meet the Coaches' heading and no trainer/coach-section|card|profile testids (legitimate 'Professional trainers' amenity copy in the Why section stat is not a trainer placeholder and was excluded).

checks.criterion: Enquiry forms and enquiry modals are removed everywhere
checks.name: enquiry-forms-removed
checks.evidence: Homepage and /branches/asif-nagar rendered 0 <form> elements and 0 text/tel/textarea inputs; branch-hero-call-button href=tel:9998887772 and branch-hero-directions-button href pointed to google.com/maps.

checks.criterion: The Floor Is Waiting section remains ready for future supplied photos but current gallery photos are removed
checks.name: floor-is-waiting-empty-gallery
checks.evidence: gallery-section shows 'The floor is waiting.' heading and gallery-copy explanatory text, contains 0 tags and 0 lightbox-testid elements.

checks.criterion: Branch essentials remain usable after removals
checks.name: branch-essentials-usable
checks.evidence: /branches/puranapool showed correct hero heading, full address containing 'Puranapool', phone 9998887774, '6:00 AM — 12:00 AM', visible map iframe, tel call button, Google Maps directions link, services section, >=1 branch gallery photo, and footer.

checks.criterion: Updated navigation stays clean and mobile usable
checks.name: mobile-navigation-clean
checks.evidence: 390x844 viewport: mobile-navigation opened with exactly About/Services/Branches/Gallery links plus 'Find a branch' CTA, no membership/trainer/coach/enquiry/placeholder dead links, and no document horizontal overflow.
